_contract.description: Synthetic golden vector for production Touch ID approval v2 (issue 49 PR A). Software P-256 key; no private key is committed. Verify, never re-sign: ECDSA signatures are randomized.
_contract.framing: Each transcript field is a 4-byte big-endian length followed by the field bytes, in the listed order.
approval_fields: provider_identity: 32 raw bytes of SHA-256(provider TLS leaf certificate DER), the companion's pin
approval_client: 32 raw bytes of SHA-256(client mTLS leaf certificate DER)
key_id: 32 raw bytes of SHA-256(65-byte uncompressed SEC1 public key)
review_digest: 32 raw bytes of SHA-256(canonical JSON of the review object)
_contract.review_digest: SHA-256 over the review JSON object with members sorted by key (bytewise), no whitespace, serde_json string escaping (\" \\ \b \f \n \r \t, other controls \u00xx lowercase, non-ASCII literal UTF-8), integers in shortest decimal form.
_contract.signature: ECDSA P-256 SHA-256, ASN.1 DER, unpadded base64url, at most 72 bytes.
_contract.public_key: unpadded base64url of the 65-byte uncompressed SEC1 point (0x04 || X || Y).
_contract.hex: All SHA-256 identifiers on the wire are 64 lowercase hex characters.

review.one_time: Approval authorizes one protected execution. Lock or cancellation stops its descendants.
